text:
Yuki: Hey team — where can I find logs/metrics/traces for client=zenith, model=summarize-v2, route=/api/v1/summarize in ap-sg? Seeing p95 latency spikes since ~08:20. Would love a saved search + dashboard link and if anyone can suggest alert threshold tuning.
Sam: Quick one — use this saved search as a starting point: https://logs.redwood.company/saved/2045. My query: 
```
org:zenith AND model:summarize-v2 AND route:"/api/v1/summarize" AND region:ap-sg
| sort desc timestamp
```
Sam: Also recommend adding status:(5xx OR 429) and kv_cache_miss:true filters to catch backend/cache issues.
Marta: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.company/dashboards/p95-latency?model=summarize-v2&org=zenith — p95 is ~1.35s right now. Current alert is 1.0s, which is noisy. Suggest bumping to 1.5s and add a sliding window (3/5) to avoid transient blips.
Lee: I'll create a saved variant and pin it for ops. For KV miss investigation use: 
```
org:zenith AND route:"/api/v1/summarize" AND kv_cache_miss:true | stats count() by shard
```
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: service=router-summarize tag=canary-2026-03-17T08:15Z by @sam — status: success :rocket:
ops-bot: Linked dashboard + saved search: https://console.redwood.company/dashboards/1234 and https://logs.redwood.company/saved/2045 (saved-search TTL=30d).
Yuki: Awesome, thanks all. Lee — can you post the saved-search id here once pinned? Sam — can you open a quick PR to loosen the alert to 1.5s? I'll follow up in the morning. :thumbsup:
Lee: Saved search created id=204567-zenith-summarize-ap-sg-p95-errors (link: https://logs.redwood.company/saved/204567) — pinned to #eng-sre.
Sam: PR opened to update alert rules: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/789 — cc @Marta for review.
Yuki: Great — marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if trend continues.
